description: This file defines the TelemetryImplementation class within the WPEFramework plugin namespace. It declares interfaces, nested classes, and methods related to telemetry reporting, power management notifications, and configuration handling. The file includes class definitions, interface implementations, and method signatures for telemetry and power management functionalities.

classes.name: TelemetryImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing telemetry and configuration interfaces, managing notifications, power management, and telemetry reporting.

classes.name: PowerManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class handling power mode change notifications from PowerManager.

classes.name: UserSettingsNotification
classes.description: Nested class handling user settings notifications, conditionally compiled based on HAS_RBUS.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Nested class representing asynchronous telemetry jobs dispatched via Core::IDispatch.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static method to get or set the singleton instance of TelemetryImplementation.

methods.name: LogApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event with name and value.

methods.name: SetOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Sets the opt-out status for telemetry.

methods.name: IsOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Checks if telemetry opt-out is enabled.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Reads content from a specified file.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the provided service.

methods.name: notifyT2PrivacyMode
methods.description: Notifies privacy mode change (conditional on HAS_RBUS).

methods.name: onReportUploadStatus
methods.description: Handles report upload status updates (conditional on HAS_RBUS).

methods.name: setRFCReportProfiles
methods.description: Sets RFC report profiles (conditional on HAS_RBUS).
